When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2279-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.

Repeat from step 1.

Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.

Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a land creature.

When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.

Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
